records.name: Cursor for iOS
records.tagline: Build with coding agents from anywhere
records.description: Cursor is now available as a native iOS app in public beta, so you can build from anywhere. Until now, developers have worked around the limits of their local machines, keeping laptops half-open and caffeinated everywhere they go. With Cursor for iOS, you can launch always-on agents in the cloud, or control agents running on your computer from your phone. Kick them off when ideas strike, get notified when work is ready for review, and merge PRs on the go.

records.name: Foresight by Lightning Rod
records.tagline: Predict anything with AI
records.description: Foresight by Lightning Rod is an OpenAI-compatible forecasting API for developers building agents, prediction-market bots, and decision tools. Ask a question about a future event and get a scored, calibrated forecast back. Unlike general-purpose LLMs, Foresight is trained and evaluated on real-world outcomes, with benchmark-verified accuracy, cheaper inference, and a drop-in API for forecasting workflows.

records.name: DropK
records.tagline: The tray that doesn't pretend
records.description: Text, files, images, folders - all in a single drop zone you drag into and pull out of naturally. It's the landing spot for "the messy middle of Mac work." and it can still keep tracking your clipboard. When on a project, clear your slate, work through everything, and DropK will have all related copied files/text ready and neatly arranged. It doesn't duplicate your files, opening files, text, all happen through saved paths, not duplicates. That's a genuinely missing link from all apps out there.

records.name: Browser Agent
records.tagline: Browser agent that’s 10x faster than Claude
records.description: Pluno just killed Claude in the browser. Claude clicks around the UI like a drunk intern - instead, Pluno talks directly to the API to act 10x faster, with 10x fewer tokens. Learns new tools instantly and uses every web app like a pro. Tested and outperformed Claude in 500+ web apps. Claude clicks - Pluno gets it done. Launch day: get $50 in free credits.

records.name: Akiflow
records.tagline: Manage tasks and calendars from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor
records.description: Akiflow is a digital planner and calendar for centralising tasks, unifying schedules, and optimising productivity., built for busy professionals! Experience the world's #1 Time Blocking app.

records.name: Tinkerfont
records.tagline: Free font playground for live websites
records.description: Tinkerfont is a free Chrome Extension and Firefox Add-on for designers, developers, and tinkerers who want to experiment with fonts on real websites -- without opening DevTools, touching the design system, or editing a stylesheet.

records.name: v0 Design Systems 2.0
records.tagline: Build with your components, colors, fonts, and patterns
records.description: v0 Design Systems 2.0 is here. You can now import your system from the sources your team already uses: GitHub repos, public and private npm packages, Storybook and docs, Figma frames, screenshots, ZIPs, and real apps. v0 learns how your design system is actually used and creates a playground with your components and tokens. Preview the result, keep iterating in chat, and save it when it's ready.

records.name: iVox
records.tagline: The first app dedicated to 1980s tape-edit effects.
records.description: iVox brings the lost art of tape multi-editing to your own computer. Inspired by the legendary editing style of The Latin Rascals, Omar Santana, and Chep Nunez — the pioneers who defined 80s freestyle, hip-hop, and the megamix era.

records.name: Justwrite
records.tagline: A private, local-first writing space that works offline
records.description: Justwrite is a distraction-free notes app for fast, private writing. No login, no cloud dependency, autosave, offline support, focus mode, markdown shortcuts, exports, and ambient writing modes.

records.name: Supafax
records.tagline: Email-native assistant that learns how you work
records.description: Supafax is an email-native assistant that learns how you work and prioritizes your inbox, drafts replies, and schedules meetings end-to-end.

records.name: Bilt.me - Figma
records.tagline: Get a real mobile app from your Figma design
records.description: You designed the whole thing in Figma. Then you had to hire someone to rebuild it by hand, pixel by pixel, and it came out "close enough." Not anymore. Drop your Figma frames into Bilt and they become a real app for iPhone. Your spacing, your fonts, your colors, exactly. You even own the code.

records.name: Clade
records.tagline: AI COO that runs your team in tools you already use
records.description: Clade is your AI COO for teams. It lives in Telegram, Slack, and iMessage, so there's no new dashboard to babysit - you message it like a teammate. Clade chases status updates, keeps client and project work moving, drafts the follow-ups, and flags what's slipping before it becomes a fire. The web app is your cockpit when you want the full picture. Built for teams who'd rather ship than manage.

records.name: Oakamo
records.tagline: Your quiet space for reading articles later.
records.description: The web is full of great content, but reading later often means distractions, ads, and endless tabs. I built Oakamo to make reading enjoyable again. Save articles from anywhere, organize them in your personal library, read in a clean distraction-free reader, highlight important passages, and listen on the go. Oakamo is built for people who love reading and want a calmer, more thoughtful way to enjoy the web.

records.name: Brain2Qwerty v2
records.tagline: Decode sentences directly from non-invasive brain signals
records.description: Brain2Qwerty v2 is a non-invasive brain-computer interface from Meta that decodes raw MEG brain signals into text. Using end-to-end deep learning and LLMs, it reaches up to 78% word accuracy without surgery.

records.name: AgentPeek
records.tagline: Your coding agents, in the Mac notch
records.description: You're running more coding agents than ever, but you can't keep up with them. That's where AgentPeek comes in. It pulls every session up into your Mac notch, live. Glance up, approve a prompt, watch token usage and manage the entire flow without pausing your YouTube video. All local, all yours.

records.name: Dayflow
records.tagline: Open source tools that help you get promoted
records.description: Getting promoted isn't just about doing great work - it's about remembering and proving it. Can you remember what you accomplished 23 weeks ago? Dayflow is a local-first macOS app that uses your screen data and AI to automatically journal your workday. No timers, no manual logging. Every bug fixed, doc written, and problem solved is captured - ready for standups, 1:1s, and performance reviews. Run any model (local or cloud), keep everything on your Mac. Open source, MIT licensed.

records.name: Midway Chat
records.tagline: Real-time member chat for Memberstack and Webflow sites
records.description: Midway is one iframe embed, built specifically around Memberstack auth and Webflow, so setup takes minutes. Members get real-time DMs, voice notes, replies, reactions, typing indicators, read receipts, online presence, and chat-request gating to block spam. Your site stays the home of your community.

records.name: Skills Marketplace by Databox
records.tagline: Ready-made AI analytics skills for your business data
records.description: A library of ready-made skills for paid ads, website performance, ecommerce, revenue, and more. Each skill pulls from your live performance data and returns a finished, shareable report in under a minute. Run them in Claude when you want answers in chat, or schedule them in n8n to land in Slack or email automatically. Free to download.

records.name: Load Nova
records.tagline: An AI co-pilot and dashboard built for dispatcher speed
records.description: One workspace for dispatchers. Less tab switching. Smarter freight. Load Nova is a Chrome side panel and Dashboard that lives next to your load board. Parse broker emails, calculate real RPM & profit, plan routes with live weather — end-to-end in under 3 minutes. No tab switching. Key features: Unified dispatch dashboard AI-assisted load planning Driver and load management Route & HOS awareness Email and workflow automation Real-time operational insights Work inside ChatGPT

records.name: NEO Assistant
records.tagline: AI receptionist that turns website visitors into customers
records.description: NEO is an AI receptionist for websites that answers visitor questions, captures enquiries, supports bookings and works from your business content.

records.name: TeamRally
records.tagline: Plan company events without spreadsheet chaos.
records.description: TeamRally is an HR event management and team operations platform built for 40–150 person remote teams. It handles event RSVPs, team preference tracking, celebrations (birthdays, work anniversaries, milestones), offsite logistics, and collaborative digital milestone cards. With native Basecamp and Slack integration, most employee interaction happens right inside the tools your team already uses—while TeamRally runs the backend and gives HR a clean dashboard. Free up to 15 members.

records.name: FeverPlanet — Famous Sights Near You
records.tagline: Find amazing places near you and around the world.
records.description: FeverPlanet finds world-famous landmarks, museums, and hidden gems near your location — with photos, hours, and travel guides.

records.name: Number Guessr
records.tagline: The classic number-guessing game, reimagined for iPhone
records.description: A modern multiplayer reimagining of the classic Bulls & Cows number guessing game. Play solo with daily global challenges, or go head-to-head with friends in real-time matches. Built from scratch in SwiftUI with Supabase Realtime — fast, beautiful, and addictive in 5-minute sessions.

records.name: Andy Anxiety & Stress Tracker
records.tagline: Free anxiety tracker. Spot your triggers, not just your mood
records.description: Most mood apps track how you feel. Andy tries to track WHY. Log your anxiety in seconds, then see patterns across time of day, weekday, and activities so you stop guessing what triggers you. Built for people who want to understand their anxiety, and want to bring something in to their next therapy session. You can also export a clean PDF with all your data.

records.name: EatSense 2.0
records.tagline: Gut tracking with a mascot that mirrors your day
records.description: EatSense is a gut health journal. You log meals, symptoms, and bathroom trips, and it surfaces the patterns behind how you feel. This update is all about Bella, our mascot. She is now fully hand-animated (We use Rive btw) and reacts to your day in real time. The more you log, the happier she gets. Calm on a quiet morning, beaming on a full day of tracking. Gut tracking is usually a chore. Bella makes it something you actually want to come back to : )

records.name: OctoVaultAI
records.tagline: Your private AI paperwork vault. Locally.
records.description: OctoVault turns your local documents into a private knowledge graph, so you can ask questions, trace facts to their source, and keep every byte on your device.

records.name: Sniplyx AI
records.tagline: Full AI video editor in your browser
records.description: Sniplyx AI isn't just a clipper, it's a full AI video editing suite. While most tools only extract clips, we combine viral clip detection, AI-generated B-roll, AI music & SFX, and auto transcription, all in one browser-based editor. Pricing starts at just $2, something no competitor offers, and we use simple flat credits instead of confusing per-minute charges most editors rely on. One tool replaces five.

records.name: lidito
records.tagline: Turn long videos into viral clips with AI
records.description: lidito finds the most viral moments in your YouTube videos, podcasts, and streams — automatically. Paste a URL. AI scores every segment for virality (hook strength, pacing, engagement signal). You get a ranked list of clips, captions already burned in, ready to post. No manual scrubbing. No editing. 5 minutes instead of 45. → AI virality scoring on every clip → Animated captions in multiple styles → Works from any YouTube URL - no download needed

records.name: Voclip
records.tagline: Turn voice notes into beautiful shareable videos.
records.description: Some of us have a lot to say but would rather speak it than type it. Some of us love sharing our thoughts but don't want to show our face. Voclip is built for you. Just tap, speak, and watch your voice transform into a beautiful, shareable video — no camera, no editing, no face required. Pick from 7 stunning templates with real-time waveform animations, then post to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and more. Perfect for introverts, podcasters, and anyone whose voice says it better than text.

records.name: Valuein
records.tagline: Auditable SEC financial data your AI agent can't hallucinate
records.description: Equity research and financial analysis, minus the grind. Valuein is the data + intelligence layer that makes analysts, researchers and quants effective on day one: screen, value, monitor and write the memo without fighting your data. Survivorship-free, PIT SEC facts + smart-money signals for 19,000+ US companies since 1993. Plug into your stack: AI agents (Claude/Cursor) via MCP 75 tools + 27 analyst workflows, the Workspace, or Python. Every number traces to its filing, no AI hallucinations.

records.name: Telori
records.tagline: AI coach for turning life goals into daily action
records.description: Telori is an AI goal planner and execution coach that helps you build the life you keep imagining. Add your vision; Telori turns it into milestones, goals, habits, and today’s next step, then keeps you moving with supportive micro-coaching, progress check-ins, and adaptive re-planning when life changes. Less cold to-do list, more personal momentum system.

records.name: TAM Tool
records.tagline: total addressable market tool with web UI and MCP
records.description: Size any US industry in seconds. Establishments, employment, payroll, GDP, and occupation wages — sourced from Census, BEA, BLS, IRS, and SEC filings.

records.name: stem_sketch_pad
records.tagline: Explore, paint, learn and get inspired by STEM subjects!
records.description: Explore, paint, learn and get inspired by hundreds STEM subjects for your kids. All free

records.name: SuperCurate Photos
records.tagline: Search photos by description
records.description: Search your photo library in plain English — "sunset beach," "dog at the park," "handwritten notes." SuperCurate surfaces the photo instantly. All AI runs on-device, so nothing is uploaded. Works fully offline on iPhone and Mac.

records.name: SimpsonESL.com
records.tagline: education ESL lesson generator English Completed
records.description: Generates complete preschool ESL lesson packages for ages 3–6 in one click — flashcards, worksheets, lesson plans, tests, and Big Picture scenes. Built for ESL centers and preschools. $20/month flat.

records.name: Felt Weather
records.tagline: A weather app that plans around how your day will feel.
records.description: Felt Weather is an iPhone weather-aware planner. It reads live weather and your calendar, draws them on one comfort curve called the Day Ribbon, and tells you what to bring, what to wear, and when to leave. The Window Finder ranks the best 30, 60, and 90-minute windows for a walk, run, or commute. It has an Apple Watch app, keeps your weather and calendar on your device, and has no tracking. Free on the App Store for iOS 17 and later.

records.name: ShadySide
records.tagline: Find the better side to sit on and avoid sun while traveling
records.description: ShadySide helps you pick the better side to sit on during bus, train, or car journeys using your route, departure time, sun position, and weather conditions. This stable relaunch brings a smoother planning experience with recent and favourite routes, shareable trip cards, accuracy feedback, a public status page, improved trip validation, clearer results, faster loading, and refreshed support pages. Built for commuters, travellers, tourists, and sun-sensitive seat pickers.

records.name: wiesnerenterprisesnz
records.tagline: Learn tiling in your own time for a one off low price
records.description: Expert tiling training from start to finish. 8 modules, 20 lessons, 4 calculators. Works 100% offline. Available on Android, Windows, and direct download.

records.name: AeroFlip Walk Lighter FlipFlops
records.tagline: Lightweight comfort flip-flops for travel and everyday life
records.description: AeroFlip Walk Lighter Flip-Flops are designed for people who value comfort, travel and everyday adventure. Featuring the AeroFlow sole, AeroFlip combines lightweight construction, soft cushioning and water-friendly materials to create a flip-flop that feels comfortable from the beach to the city. Join early and secure an exclusive 20% launch discount.

records.name: Wauvel
records.tagline: CFO-level finance for businesses too small to hire one.
records.description: Upload your monthly financials. Get a plain-English report on your business — what's working, what's not, and what to do about it. Built for small business owners.

records.name: Exfault
records.tagline: Agentic Mobile Security Engineer
records.description: Exfault is an autonomous mobile security researcher for Android apps, using AI agents, static analysis, dynamic analysis, authenticated workflows, and real Android cloud emulators to produce reproducible security findings. Exfault combines static and dynamic analysis with AI agents. The AI agents have access to real Android emulators to peform navigation, explore functionality and validate vulnerabilities before reporting them, improving both the quality of reports and false positive rates.

records.name: Recipunk
records.tagline: Save recipes from the web without ads, popups or SEO-slop.
records.description: A dead-simple web app for saving your favourite internet recipes in a kitchen-friendly format — without the ads, trackers, pop-ups and auto-play videos. Copy, paste and you're done.

records.name: Talon
records.tagline: AI builds your daily habit. One goal. One action at a time.
records.description: Most habit apps give you a plan and leave you alone. Talon gives you actions to take every day. Set one goal. Talon's AI generates a focused action based on your experience and progress. Complete it. Check in. The next one adapts. No crazy dashboards. No guilt-driven streaks. One action per day that builds real momentum. Inspired by Atomic Habits: small daily actions compound into real results. You don't need motivation. You need a system. Built for people done planning and ready to move.

records.name: LocalEmu
records.tagline: Run 132 AWS services locally. Free, open-source emulator
records.description: Stop waiting on cloud deploys and paying for dev AWS accounts. LocalEmu is a free, open-source AWS emulator. One pip install and one command gives you 132 AWS services on localhost:4566. Point the AWS CLI, boto3, Terraform, CDK or Pulumi straight at it, with zero config. Real Docker engines for Lambda, EC2, RDS, ECS and EKS. State persists across restarts. No account, no token, no telemetry. Apache 2.0. Build, test and learn AWS locally in seconds, not minutes.

records.name: OutboundQA
records.tagline: Catch cold email launch blockers before you send
records.description: Catch cold email launch blockers before you send. Upload sending domains, inboxes, and tracking domains to get a Ready, Needs Fix, or Do Not Launch verdict with exact fixes and a shareable report. Upload a CSV of your sending domains, inboxes, and tracking domains. OutboundQA runs 15 infrastructure checks (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, domain age, blacklists, tracking SSL) and returns one verdict: Ready, Needs Fix, or Do Not Launch. Plus a report you can send a client.

records.name: GlassPing
records.tagline: Let strangers reach your car, never your number
records.description: GlassPing is a $5 QR sticker for your windshield. Anyone who needs to reach you scans it, sends a message or photo, and you get an instant push ping - no app for them, no number from you. One-time payment, unlimited messages, your number never leaves your pocket.

records.name: LexAPI
records.tagline: Authoritative EU law for your AI agent, via MCP
records.description: One MCP server that gives any AI agent — Claude, Cursor, or your own — authoritative EU law: semantic search across EU legislation and Court of Justice case law, citation graphs, and full documents from EUR-Lex. Open-source. Free to explore.

records.name: Tracking Languages: Netflix, YT & Prime
records.tagline: Comprehensible input time tracker for language learners
records.description: A Chrome extension that tracks every minute you watch in your target language on Netflix, YouTube, and Prime Video. Daily goals, streaks, and a garden that grows with you.

records.name: Lumina Social — Social Networking UI Kit
records.tagline: A premium Flutter social UI kit — 20+ screens, MD3, BloC.
records.description: - Production-ready code — Not just mockups. Every screen is a fully functional Flutter widget. - Clean Architecture — Feature-first structure with Bloc/Cubit state management. Easy to extend. - Dual theme mastery — Two complete Material Design 3 color schemes (light + dark) with proper surface hierarchy. - RTL & Arabic — Full right-to-left layout support with Arabic localization. Expand your audience. - Responsive by default — Fluid grids adapt from mobile (4-col) to desktop (12-col) seamlessly.

records.name: Zebra — Symptom tracker for POTS, EDS
records.tagline: Track POTS, EDS & Fibro — and prove it to your doctor
records.description: Zebra is an iPhone symptom tracker built for POTS, EDS & Fibromyalgia — together. Track flares, symptoms, meds, salt, water and a guided orthostatic test in under 60 seconds, then export a doctor-ready PDF for your next appointment. On-device. Not medical advice.

records.name: The Conversion Atlas
records.tagline: Convert any unit. No clutter, just the answer.
records.description: Free online unit converter — kg to lbs, mm to inches, cm to inches, Celsius to Fahrenheit, km to miles, liters to gallons and 674 more conversions.

records.name: DocWeave
records.tagline: Screenshot to polished SOP, training guide, or runbook
records.description: DocWeave is a Windows app that turns annotated screenshots into professional SOPs, training manuals, and runbooks — then exports to PDF, Word, PowerPoint, HTML, and Markdown in one click. Capture, annotate, assemble, export. 100% offline, no account. 15-day free trial.

records.tagline: Split any song into stems — offline, on-device, free
records.description: Split vocals, drums, bass & instruments on Android with Stemify. Fully offline, on-device AI — no uploads, completely private. Free on Google Play.

records.description: a fun little companion while you're coding

What you can do: 🔎 Search by text, number range, or date range 📄 Browse matching records one at a time ✏️ Edit records directly from the sidebar 🟨 Highlighted fields before saving 📝 Auto-log changes with before/after values Perfect for anyone who regularly updates records in Google Sheets.

Pro at €5/month.

records.name: Fireslide

records.description: Fireslide turns your prompt into a polished, on-brand deck in seconds — then you and the AI refine it together in one editor: edit any slide by hand, or just ask the AI to change it. Same canvas, your call. Designer-grade style templates auto-match your topic, with real images, logos, news and charts baked in. It runs inside your AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) — and it's free. Emphasizing human–AI cooperation.

records.name: mono

records.name: Alteris Docs

Everything runs locally. Free plan available. Pro from €249/year.

records.name: Runlog — ML Training Monitor
